task.title: To change the chatter feed group

ul.li: The X-Author Outlook add-in must have been installed and you are connected.
You must be a member of at least one Chatter group

step.cmd: Select an existing group from the Groups list

info.p: Click Search Group and select the desired group from the Groups search window.

result.p: If you have the Chatter feed displayed you will see the feed update to display the group you selected.
